name: SH-1: hard-excluded threat → suppressed (hardExcluded), never clean

suppressed.detail: Excluded by a confirmed authoritativeMismatch observation.
Excluded by a confirmed trustedWitnessOK observation.

expected.explanation: Inconclusive: the evidence does not affirmatively resolve to clean or to any threat.

why: W02 (ReportCard.cs:88 / :83): dnsSpoofing carries real observed support (authoritativeMismatch) but is hard-excluded by firing trustedWitnessOK at/above the 0.5 exclusion-firing threshold. A hard-excluded threat must surface as a suppression with reason hardExcluded and must never let the run read clean — hasThreatOverhang counts HardExcluded suppressions. Same conflicting evidence also hard-excludes clean (authoritativeMismatch is an exclusionary indicator for it), which is exactly why the run abstains. Shared fixture for Task 1.8 cross-runtime parity.
